lines: Two-agent QA → Coder loop for a known bug
Add --autonomous to skip the acceptance gate (never commits)

card.summary: Two-agent QA → Coder loop for a known bug. Failing test first, smallest change to make it pass. Writes a per-fix folder under docs/waves/fix-{slug}/. Personas live in .claude/agents/.
card.paragraph: QA → Coder loop against one reproducible bug. Interview → render prompt → user acceptance → loop. The Coder cannot edit test files; touching them halts the loop. On close-out, writes a per-fix folder under docs/waves/fix-{slug}/ containing fix-report.html (human-readable summary) and fix-state.json (machine-readable record), plus refreshes the cross-fix index at docs/waves/fix-wiki.html.
use_when: You want failing test first, then minimal fix
dontuse_when: You don't have a repro yet

invocations.comment: Autonomous — skip acceptance gate; forces no-commit

extras.title: Artifacts produced (v1.3+)
items: docs/waves/fix-{slug}/fix-report.html — per-fix human-readable report (one folder per fix, slug derived from the bug title)
docs/waves/fix-{slug}/fix-state.json — per-fix machine-readable state record (iteration count, halt reason, files touched, test outcomes)
docs/waves/fix-wiki.html — cross-fix index page linking every fix-{slug}/ folder, regenerated on each close-out

extras.title: Halt conditions
items: Coder weakens or skips an assertion
Lint/build fails for an unrelated reason
--autonomous does not bypass any halt condition above — it only skips the acceptance gate and forces no-commit.
